title: Spoke activity log: session outcomes in Quartermaster + Cartographer anomaly surface
one_liner: Expose per-spoke session outcome history so Cartographer can surface fleet anomalies.
description: Each spoke already has session tracks in WAI-Spoke/sessions/*/track.jsonl. The signal value is not in the raw logs but in anomalies: INTERRUPTED sessions (lost work risk), gardener-only streaks (no human sessions), dormant spokes. Quartermaster scan should add last_session_outcome per spoke (CLEAN/INTERRUPTED/GARDENER/EMPTY) and session frequency (last 7 days). Cartographer renders this as a fleet-pulse section showing anomalies only, not raw dumps.

perceive.current_state: Quartermaster scans cross-spoke inventory (lugs, signals, stale work) but does not read session track outcomes. Cartographer renders spoke health scores and decisions but has no session activity view.

steps: 1. In quartermaster_scan.py: for each spoke, scan WAI-Spoke/sessions/ sorted by date, take the last 7 days of sessions, classify each as CLEAN (track ends with completed=true or event=closeout), INTERRUPTED (track non-empty but no closeout), GARDENER (committed by gardener commit pattern), or EMPTY (no track entries). Write last_session_outcome + session_counts_7d to per-spoke output.

2. In cartologist_report.py: add fleet_pulse section to the report JSON using quartermaster session data. Flag anomalies: INTERRUPTED sessions, spokes with 0 human sessions in 7 days, spokes dormant > 14 days.
3. In latest.html template: add a fleet-pulse panel showing only anomalies (not raw log). INTERRUPTED badge, gardener-only streak badge, dormant indicator. Healthy spokes collapse to a summary line.

done_when: quartermaster_scan.py output includes last_session_outcome per spoke
Cartographer report.json includes fleet_pulse section with anomaly flags
latest.html fleet-pulse panel shows INTERRUPTED spokes highlighted
Healthy spokes do not generate noise (collapsed or omitted)

acceptance_criteria: Cartographer surfaces INTERRUPTED sessions without requiring manual spoke inspection
Gardener-only streaks visible at fleet level (no human sessions in N days)
Raw session log is NOT displayed — only derived anomaly signals
